title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-12
content:
2026-03-03 - personal scratchpad

Top of mind:
- Urgent: capacity for model-x rollout (est. +60% peak token qps next month). Need node add/cold start test plan.
- RDMA flakiness on p4-48 during long tails; suspected NIC firmware mismatch after last maintenance window.

Morning the list (quick wins first):
- [ ] Re-run capacity simulation with model-x traffic profile (use historical sample from 2026-02-20).
  - script: ./tools/capacity/simulate.py --profile profiles/model-x.json --duration 2h --output /tmp/sim-modelx-20260303.csv
- [ ] File INFRA-4871 with initial node-sizing recommendation + cost delta.
- [ ] Check RDMA patch status on p4-48 and p4-52: ssh ops@p4-48 "sudo ethtool -i eth0"; compare driver/firmware versions.
- [ ] Schedule brief w/ networking (Marco) to decide on roll-forward vs rollback for NIC FW.

Observability / metrics to scan:
- GPU utilization (5m avg per-pod) across serving cluster: grafana:gpu-serving/d-snapshot. Look for sustained > 80% on 2026-02-28 14:00-17:00 window.
- KV cache hit rates by model version (model-x vs model-x-quant): query: sum(kv_cache_hits)/sum(kv_cache_requests) by (model_version)
- Latency p95 for short prompts (<64 tokens) vs long prompts (>1024 tokens).

Notes from last incident (2026-02-20):
- Symptom: long-tail latency spikes (~2x p95) after autoscaler added nodes.
- Root cause: two new nodes had incorrect MTU (1500 vs 9000), causing packet fragmentation on large KV transfers.
- Mitigation: set nodepool-sysctl DaemonSet to enforce mtu=9000 + rolling restart.
- Action item: run cluster-wide mtu audit script before next scale event.

MTU audit quick commands:
- kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.status.addresses[0].address}
'
- ssh node "ip link show eth0 | grep mtu" || echo missing

TODO (detailed):
- Capacity & infra
  - [ ] Finalize model-x traffic mix and update sim inputs (deadline 2026-03-05).
  - [ ] Dry-run adding 8 nodes to staging serving pool; validate autoscaler + canary routing. (Jamie)
  - [ ] Run cost model with quantized variant (Q5) to compare unit cost/token.

- Networking
  - [ ] Confirm NIC firmware parity across p4 fleet. Patch plan if mismatch > 10% of nodes.
  - [ ] Add MTU audit to pre-scale checklist and to k8s cluster-autoscaler hook (short script).

- GPU ops / maintenance
  - [ ] Bake image with updated nv-peer-mem and rdma-core recommended for kernel 5.15. (test on staging)
  - [ ] Validate DCGM exporter metrics after kernel bump; ensure no regressions in sm_utilization metrics ingestion.
  - [ ] Prepare runbook for partial node drain during firmware updates (target <15 min disruption per shard).

Open questions / decisions:
- Can we accept 10% performance regression from Q5 quantization if it halves cost? Need product tradeoff (ping product-hosted-api).
- Is it worth accelerating NIC firmware rollout pre-rollout or wait until after smoke tests? Pros/cons doc needed.

Funny/notes to self:
- Remember to push the staging canary at 11:00am to catch the team for pairing.
- Bring coffee to infra standup tomorrow - will need it.

Quick links:
- /contrib/tools/capacity/README.md
- https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gpu-serving/cluster-overview

End of day checklist:
- [ ] Update INFRA-4823 with results from today's sim runs.
- [ ] Post short note in #infra-updates summarizing ND-level impacts and schedule for NIC FW change.
